profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Signify Health
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer and Technical Lead with 12+ years of experience architecting and operating distributed backend and platform systems in regulated domains. Proven record modernizing legacy systems and improving production reliability at scale. Actively leveraging AI-assisted development workflows and exploring applied machine learning integration within production systems.



Core Strengths:

• Architecture & System Design (distributed systems, service boundaries, and design tradeoffs)

• Backend & Platform Engineering (APIs, data pipelines, event-driven systems, and prod. grade services)

• Production-Grade System Foundations (production correctness, observability, and auditability)

• Legacy Modernization & Performance Optimization

• AI-Enabled Engineering Workflows (Copilot, Cursor, LLM-assisted refactoring)

• Applied Machine Learning Exploration (Predictive Systems)

• Hands-on Technical Leadership (mentorship, design reviews, execution alignment, and delivery)

Technical Skills:

• Languages: C#, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Ruby, C/C++

• Backend & Platform: .NET Core, Spring Boot, Node.js, APIs, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Arch.

• Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, NServiceBus

• Cloud & DevOps: Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)

• Observability & Testing: New Relic, Kibana, NUnit, JUnit, Cypress

• AI-Assisted Engineering: GitHub Copilot, Cursor (LLM-assisted refactoring, test generation, code exploration)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led architecture and system design of distributed, cloud-native healthcare applications, delivering scalable solutions for provider pay automation and preventive care coordination.

• Introduced AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate refactoring, test coverage expansion, and architectural analysis across backend services.

• Leveraged AI code-generation and review tools to reduce implementation cycle time and improve engineering throughput while maintaining production reliability standards.

• Developed and launched a new automated provider pay system, streamlining workflows and improving accuracy.

• Directed migration & decommissioning of legacy systems, including data extraction and compliance for retired clients, ensuring seamless platform transitions.

• Established KPI observability (New Relic, Backstage) and enterprise CI/CD pipelines with >80% automated test coverage, reducing deployment errors and improving production visibility.

• Provided production support for critical Clinical Services applications, diagnosing and resolving high-severity incidents to maintain system uptime and reliability.

• Mentored and coached engineers on coding standards, system design, and DevOps best practices, improving overall code quality and team performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized full-stack in-house healthcare application to enhance patient-provider engagement and ensure scalability.

• Designed database schemas and data pipelines while improving system reliability and responsiveness for healthcare applications.

• Implemented authentication, authorization, and security best practices, ensuring HIPAA compliance and data protection.

• Collaborated cross-functionally with product owners and UX/UI teams to refine user experience and usability.

• Onboarded and trained developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project Team Lead:
• Worked closely with clients to define business requirements for project estimations.
• Developed roadmaps to meet projects deadlines.
• Determined what technologies to use for the project.
• Designed the applications’ architecture.
• Setup source controls and protocols for development, testing and deployment builds.
• Set up environments for continuing integration and testing.
• Organized and managed tasks for every sprint.
• Served as the platform technical lead for complex issues.
• Reported project status to project managers.
• Monitored and mentored team members to ensure the project is on track.

Front-End Developer:
• Developed prototypes.
• Worked with designers to develop the best graphical user interface (GUI) for web and mobile devices.
• Wrote quality, scalable, and maintainable code, while adhering to coding standards.
• Collaborated with the client’s back-end developers’ team to accomplish required project tasks.
• Found the best and most efficient solutions to problems.
• Stay current with common practices and techniques to consistently deliver the most innovative and maintainable solutions.
• Performed code reviews for team members.
• Maintained, debugged and polished existing code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front-End Web Development 
• Developed Manta’s new web application.
• Developed MVC front-end framework with Angular.JS and Twitter Bootstrap.
• Used Agile, TDD and did pair programming to conquer each part of the new platform.
• Used Node.js with Express.JS framework and Hogan.JS for the web application’s client to server requests.
• Implementation of Manta’s web app features such as company profile, company search, pixel tracker, member profiles.
• Technologies: Angularj, Nodejs/express, HTML5, Bootstrap, CSS.
• Unit testing with Jasmine-given and CheerioJS.

Test Automation Engineer 
• Led the establishment of the company’s automation testing department.
• Developed an automation testing suite using Selenium and Cucumber for developers and manual
testers.
• Aided in the company’s adoption of agile software development by introducing the fundamental
practices of behavior driven development.
• Aided in the development of a new product deployment process involving the Amazon Web Services,
Travis and Jenkins continuous integration software, and Manta brewed tools to help monitor builds.
• In charge of the installment and setup of Jenkins and Travis Continuous Integration tools.
• In charge of spiking out performance testing tool to test services in the AWS cloud.

Internal Application Developer
Development of administrative tools written in Java, for the company’s customer service department.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
ICDA Internal Corrosion Direct Assessment Projects: 

Use flow modeling results to predict the locations most likely to have suffered internal corrosion within each LP-ICDA Liquid Petroleum Direct Assessment region. The LP-ICDA Modeling Step relies on the ability to identify locations most likely to accumulate water and solids. The process is applicable to pipelines in which stratified flow is the primary liquid transport mechanism.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
SCC Stress Corrosion Cracking Project: SCC PROBABILITY OF FAILURE MODEL  

SCC Probability of Failure Model consists of a series of algorithms that are used to assess the likelihood of stress-corrosion cracking. The results of the algorithms are used to prioritize segments of pipeline for assessment excavation and engineering assessment. The Model is designed to be applied to both forms of external SCC (near- neutral-pH SCC and high-pH SCC).
